marta: quick help — support flagged a flaky call in prod with request_id=9f7b2c. Need the raw log lines + trace spans for the ~12:03 UTC window. Fastest way to get both (console + CLI)?

ryan: fastest: open Console -> Observability -> Traces, paste the trace id (or request id) in the search. once the trace loads click "Associated Logs" to jump to the logs time window. link pattern: https://console.redwood.com/observability/traces?q=trace.id:9f7b2c

sam: CLI shortcuts if you prefer terminal:
```
# fetch trace + spans
redwoodctl traces get 9f7b2c --spans
# fetch raw logs filtered by request id (UTC time window)
redwoodctl logs query --filter "request.id=9f7b2c" --start 2026-03-16T12:00:00Z --end 2026-03-16T12:10:00Z --output raw
```

ryan: small tips:
- If the trace UI returns nothing, try searching by request.id in Traces or Traces->Advanced: `resource.attributes.request.id:9f7b2c` (some services attach it as baggage).
- When you open logs from the trace UI it sets the exact time range and adds trace_id/request_id filters for you, so it's usually quickest for ad-hoc debug.

marta: if I only have the trace id but not the request id, will the logs UI still show matching lines?

sam: yes — we push trace.trace_id into logs as `trace_id` tag. Example loki / grafana query:
```
{trace_id="9f7b2c"} |= "ERROR"
```
That will return log lines correlated to the trace id. For Datadog: search `trace_id:9f7b2c` in Logs.

ryan: also useful: if you need the original JSON payloads we log (sensitive fields are redacted), add `--output json` to redwoodctl logs query. For really large windows add `--limit 10000` and pipe to `jq` to inspect.

marta: diagnostics-bot any quick helpers?

diagnostics-bot: Automated hint: you can run `redwoodctl traces get 9f7b2c --expand-spans | redwoodctl logs query --filter "trace_id=9f7b2c" --start $(date -d '2026-03-16T12:00:00Z' -u +%s) --end $(date -d '2026-03-16T12:10:00Z' -u +%s)` to chain. See docs: https://docs.redwood.com/observability/traces#trace-to-logs

marta: perfect, thanks both — I'll grab the output and paste the key lines here. :thumbsup:

sam: ping me if you want me to redact user IDs before sharing externally.

marta: will do, thanks!
